title: Court case primary metadata
description: Written by client.save_judgment_local for every judgment from the 12 mainline court/tribunal slugs (hkcfa, hkca, hkcfi, hkdc, hkfc, hkldt, hkmagc, hkct, hkcrc, hklat, hksct, hkoat). UKPC uses a distinct shape — see ukpc-metadata.schema.json. On disk at output/{court}/{year}/{court}_{year}_{number}.json (EN or TC-primary); TC sidecar variants use the .tc.json suffix and share this schema. Optional backfill provenance fields (source, source_note, backfilled_at) mark rows fetched outside the normal getjudgment path — one such row exists in the current corpus (hkdc/2019/128.tc.json).

title.description: Party-name title in the row's language. Uppercase for EN; mixed case for TC. Empty string on rare rows with no HKLII title.

case_number.description: Primary docket for this row (e.g. 'FAMC58/2019'). One row per docket — a judgment covering N dockets appears N times with different case_number values but identical text. Empty string on the same 14 rare rows where title is also empty (HKLII phantom entries).

court.description: Court name in the row's language (e.g. 'Court of Final Appeal' in EN, '原訟法庭' in TC).

date.description: Judgment date. ISO 8601 with Hong Kong offset. Three offsets observed in the current corpus: +08:00 (98.9% of rows, standard HKT), +09:00 (~0.9%, anomalous — mostly mid-1970s hkca/hkcfi rows), +07:36:42 (~0.1%, pre-1904 rows using Hong Kong Local Mean Time). Zero empty strings observed across 162,248 rows.

neutral_citation.description: HKLII-supplied neutral citation. For pre-2018 judgments, assigned retrospectively by HKLII as catalogue metadata — not necessarily present in the body text.

parallel_citations.description: Law-report citations (HKCFAR, HKLRD, HKC, etc.). Often empty.

doc_url.description: Judiciary-hosted URL of the source Word document. Typed nullable as a defensive contract (client.py:70 coerces missing/empty to None) but 0 of 162,248 rows are null in the current corpus — HKLII ships a doc pointer on every observed row. The file on disk uses the extension chosen by magic-byte validation, not the URL suffix.

has_translation.description: HKLII flag — true iff a counterpart in the other language exists at the same (court, year, number).

url.description: Canonical HKLII URL for this row. Language derivable from the /en/ or /tc/ path segment.

source.description: OPTIONAL. Provenance marker when the row was fetched outside the normal getjudgment path (e.g. 'judiciary-docx-fallback').

source_note.description: OPTIONAL. Human-readable explanation of the fallback route. Written alongside `source`.

backfilled_at.description: OPTIONAL. YYYY-MM-DD date the backfill was performed. Written alongside `source`.
